messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

| Evidence needed | What the passages currently support | What is still missing |
|---|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense context | Randy Schnell is identified as Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test [58]. | A passage directly tying the specific Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution to an Aerospace / Defense customer, program, or requirement is not shown. |
| Our signal generator evidence | R&S SMW200A is a Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generator, with RF path A covering 100 kHz to 67 GHz and RF path B covering up to 44 GHz [1]. | A comparison-ready configuration for the Aerospace / Defense use case must be tied to the required options and measurement scenario. |
| Our signal analyzer evidence | R&S FSW is a Rohde & Schwarz high-end signal and spectrum analyzer family covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, and FSW85 with FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz [10]. | A comparison-ready analyzer configuration must specify required analysis bandwidth, software, and options for the use case. |
| Official R&S specification basis | The SMW200A specifications document records RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, and options [3]. | The exact SMW200A BOM and required options for the proposed Aerospace / Defense test must be validated against the configuration guide and specifications. |
| Official R&S analyzer specification basis | The FSW source is the Version 17.01 specifications document dated September 2025, and data without tolerance limits is not binding [12]. | Any claimed analyzer performance must distinguish warranted specifications from non-binding data. |
| Aerospace / Defense test-use evidence | The military / aviation drone EMC source frames military / aviation drones in unforgiving electromagnetic environments, multi-domain operations, and system-level effects testing [32]. | It does not provide a specific Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer product mapping or competitor comparison. |
| Standards / requirements evidence | The same source lists MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, and RTCA DO-160 as common EMC-related standards [35]. | The passages do not provide full standard limits, categories, waveforms, setups, or pass/fail criteria. |
| Scenario evidence for signal generation | The RF electromagnetic environment section lists emulating complex EME signals, evaluating military system-level effects under EM interferences, and simulating operational scenarios [31]. | It does not provide signal libraries, threat emitter models, power levels, frequency bands, synchronization, or safety conditions. |
| Scenario evidence for satellite payload testing | A TVAC satellite payload test setup can include a signal generator and signal analyzer [36]. | This supports an aerospace-type test setup, but it is not a competitor comparison. |
| Our SG/SA satellite measurement evidence | R&S FSW with R&S SMW200A can be used to measure absolute and relative group delay of satellite transponders, frequency converters, and other components [42]. | The passages do not show an equivalent competitor method with verified specifications. |
| Competitor identity evidence | Keysight is described as having strong market presence in aerospace / defense, cloud, semiconductor, and wireless testing [14]. | This does not identify a Keysight Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution for the same Aerospace / Defense measurement scenario. |
| Competitor product evidence | A Starlink UT test-flow source maps spectrum analyzer equipment to R&S FSW and Keysight N9040B UXA, and signal generator equipment to R&S SMW200A and Keysight E8257D PSG [46]. | The same source says these are deck-level recommendations and formal configuration requires checking product specifications, options, frequency range, uncertainty, and test method [46]. |
| Competitor official-document evidence | Anritsu weakness narratives in the battle card cannot be treated as Anritsu official specifications or market facts [19]. | Anritsu product frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option codes, software tools, and support model need verification from Anritsu official datasheets, release notes, or support terms [19]. |
【推論】A defensible Aerospace / Defense comparison also needs a source tying the exact use case to Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer requirements, because the current passages separately show Aerospace / Defense test context, complex EME testing needs, and satellite payload setups [31][32][36].
【推論】A defensible competitor comparison needs official competitor datasheets or equivalent verified sources for the same measurement scenario, because internal battle-card weakness narratives are not official competitor specifications or market facts [19].

passages.text:
R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › Signal routing and baseband main module
| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 原文說明 / 限制 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `R&S®SMW-B13` | Signal routing and baseband main module，one I/Q path to RF section | `1413.2807.02` | Standard baseband section；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13T` | Signal routing and baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.3003.02` | Standard baseband section；若要安裝 RF path B 需 `B13T` 或 `B13XT`；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13XT` | Wideband baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.8005.02` | Wideband baseband section；RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz`。 |

- Standard baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B10` standard baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B14` fading simulator。
- Wideband baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13XT`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B9` / `R&S®SMW-B9F` wideband baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B15` fading simulator and signal processor。

R&S SMW200A › 文件依據
- 來源：[[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator – Configuration guide`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.92`。
- 文件版次：`Version 06.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2024`。
- 文件性質：configuration guide；適合查 mandatory configuration、requires / not compatible / retrofitting notes、ordering information、recommended extras 與 service notes。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.22`。
- 文件版次：`Version 31.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2026`。
- 文件性質：產品 specifications；記錄 RF/baseband performance、interfaces、environmental data、ordering information 與 options。

R&S SMW200A › 基本訂購限制
依 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Base unit：`R&S®SMW200A`，Order No. `1412.0000.02`。
- 原文說明：Vector signal generator；includes power cable and quick start guide。
- Base unit can only be ordered with an `R&S®SMW-B10xx` frequency option and an `R&S®SMW-B13`、`R&S®SMW-B13T` or `R&S®SMW-B13XT` signal routing and baseband main module。
- 最低配置必須包含 RF path A 的一個 frequency option，以及一個 signal routing and baseband main module。
- Step 1 RF path A frequency options 不能 retrofitted。
- Step 2 baseband main module options 可 factory retrofitted；`R&S®SMW-B13XT` retrofitting only for serial number `102700` or higher。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › 規格適用條件與語彙
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）：

- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage `3 hours` 後 warm-up operation `30 minutes`、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval、完成所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance。
- `n. trc.`、`typ.`、`nom.`、`meas.` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- Uncertainties 的 coverage factor 為 `2`，依 GUM 計算。
- 依 3GPP standard，本文件中的 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 不是 SI units。

R&S SMW200A › RF path combination 與 chassis
- RF path combination table：`●` 代表 possible；`–` 代表 not possible；灰底格代表該 RF path combination 需要 `R&S®SMW-B94L` deeper chassis；白底格使用 standard chassis。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L`：Deeper chassis，Order No. `1438.8150.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L` required and only possible for RF path combinations：`2 × 12.75 GHz`、`2 × 31.8 GHz`、`2 × 44 GHz`。
- 44 GHz 組合限制：`R&S®SMW-B1044` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044N` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044N` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044O` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044O` 組合。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 典型 setup 元件
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 的 TVAC test setup 可包含：

- signal generator
- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer

- 來源未提供 [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]] 的完整 datasheet、order number、完整 environmental specification 或 ESA norms 條文。

- 本頁只記錄 2022 application brochure 的 solution-level 說法，不可視為產品 qualification certificate。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › TVAC power sensors
依來源：

- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]] power sensors 專為 TVAC 設計，符合 European Space Agency norms。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 覆蓋 up to 33 GHz。
- [[R&S NRP67SN-V]] 覆蓋 up to 67 GHz。
- 兩者可進行 fast、highly accurate power measurements。
- Dynamic range up to 93 dB。
- 量測獨立於 signal bandwidth 與 modulation type。
- 可透過 power over Ethernet LAN connection 從 chamber 外控制。
- 將 sensors 直接連接至 chamber 內 satellite input 或 output，可簡化 measurement setup 與 calibration procedure。
- 將 sensors 靠近 DUT 量測，可消除 long RF cables 的需求並改善 measurement accuracy。
- Rohde & Schwarz TVAC cables 與 special LAN feedthroughs 使用 vacuum friendly materials，並已 baked 以消除 VOC 與其他 contaminants。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法一：R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A multi-carrier group delay measurement
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 與 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 可用於快速、直接量測 satellite transponders、frequency converters 與 other components 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。
